expenses_voided_matches_status.name: expenses_voided_matches_status
expenses_voided_matches_status.value: ("expenses"."status" = 'voided') = ("expenses"."voided_by" is not null and "expenses"."void_reason" is not null)

files_subject_matches_kind.name: files_subject_matches_kind
files_subject_matches_kind.value:
("files"."kind" = 'profile_photo' and "files"."outing_id" is null and "files"."subject_id" is null)
        or ("files"."kind" <> 'profile_photo' and "files"."outing_id" is not null and "files"."subject_id" is not null)
